subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation use the existing global browser SSRF opt-in plus the shared configured provider-request policy to authorize private destinations?
rationale: This intentionally expands an outbound network boundary, and repository policy requires owner confirmation of the authorization scope even though both settings already exist.

options.title: Use shared configured-request policy
options.body: Enable the factory’s configured-request seam, retain the browser-policy hook, and require production-path deny/allow proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the local boolean read
options.body: Approve the branch’s narrower one-field implementation despite its parallel policy path and future drift risk.

options.title: Require exact-origin-only trust
options.body: Redesign xAI image requests to authorize only the configured origin if broad private-network permission is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Use shared configured-request policy
recommendation.body: Enable the factory’s configured-request seam, retain the browser-policy hook, and require production-path deny/allow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent work around the shared provider HTTP and image-generation request boundary.
